context.why: A whole ROUTE rather than a card — its root IS `.manager-main` — and the fixture is one empty array, because an empty state is by definition what a screen draws when its data is empty. It is the only context here that shows the primitive under a real section header and a real filter bar, which is the thing an empty state is judged against.

note: The lowest-drama primitive in the set, and deliberately so: one host, one class, no accessible name and no event contract. It has exactly one driveable prop, which is the honest measure of a container — the body story is the specimen, because what a card looks like is what it looks like around real content.

states.hover: Not applicable: it renders a non-interactive `<section>` with no pointer state of its own. What hovers inside it belongs to the caller's body.
states.focus-visible: Not applicable: the section takes no focus. Its contents do, so tab into the specimen on the plinth.
states.disabled: Not applicable: a container has nothing to disable, and the sheet's three further card treatments are anchored on a modifier class, an ancestor and a positioning state rather than on any state of the card itself.
states.loading: No prop. `design-system/spec.md:209` puts LOADING and ERROR on the store-fed SURFACE rather than on the shell around it, and this shell holds whatever the caller renders.
states.invalid: Not applicable: it carries no value that could be rejected.
states.readonly: Not applicable: it is read-only by construction.
states.empty: Clearing `children` renders the padded box with nothing in it, which is a card the caller should not have rendered rather than a stated empty state. `<Empty>` is the member that owns that sentence.

unknobbed.why: An EXTRA class appended to `manager-inspector-card`, never a replacement — and it is where this shell's whole variant vocabulary lives, because the sheet's three further treatments are anchored three different ways and a closed `variant` set is a design ruling left open. Driving it would have the lab publish a variant set the component deliberately does not declare.

Every other attribute — `data-*` hooks, `aria-label`, `id` — is forwarded onto the `<section>`. The set is open and none of its members is drawn; the trap it carries is that a BARE `data-*` on a component tag spreads the boolean `true`, not the empty string it is on an element.
